text:
maia: heads-up — deploy-bot kicked off preflight for the cross-service release (api/runtime/console/router). planned window 2026-03-22 02:00-04:00 UTC. pin proposal: runtime v2.4.1, api v1.13.0, console v0.9.7, router v3.2.0. please ack/raise blockers.

deploy-bot: preflight summary: unit/integration smoke ✅, infra capacity OK ✅, schema diff small (api.addTelemetry) — compatibility check passed. runbook: https://confluence/release/rb-1739994000

aj: quick q — are we doing staged traffic slicing or just flag swap? :eyes:

maia: staged. start 5% canary for 30m, then 25% for 20m, then 100% if metrics green. rollback on error rate > 1.5x baseline or p50 latency +50ms sustained 5m.

santiago: runtime team confirming KV eviction change is behind a feature flag in v2.4.1. we can disable during rollout if needed. tagging @ryan for L2 for eviction tuning.

ryan: noted. i'll monitor mem/eviction metrics and have a quick patch ready. if eviction thrash appears, we flip flag and hold traffic.

aj: console needs migration window for index refresh — we prefer the 25% stage to run after index refresh completes. can we reorder stage timing slightly?

maia: yes — plan: 5% -> index refresh job -> 25% -> 100%. add a 10m buffer after index job finishes.

ops-liaison: oncall scheduled for that window: tara (primary), ryan (backup). paging rules updated. incident channel #release-1739994000 created.

tara: i'll be live for first 30m and then on standby. pls post release notes summary in the channel when you start.

maia: release notes draft: "Cross-service rollout: updates to runtime batching kernels, API telemetry fields, console index refresh optimization, router sticky session handling." will paste final once QA thumbs up.

aj: confirm DB migration — is there any write path migration? I saw a small column add in telemetry but it's additive.

maia: telemetry field is additive. migration is online-safe. no write blocking.

santiago: small compatibility test: router v3.2.0 drops an old header 'X-RW-Stage' for internal routing. we need to ensure api still sets fallback header. candidate patch in api v1.13.0 keeps fallback.

aj: ok good.

maia: rollback criteria recap: (1) error rate >1.5x baseline over 5m (2) p50 latency +50ms 5m (3) 5% user-facing failures for >3m. rollback actions: immediate traffic revert to previous pinned versions and emergency postmortem template populated by deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: command examples — to pin back: `deploy-bot rollback --to-tag runtime:v2.4.0 --services api,console,router --reason "auto-rollback-trigger"`

ryan: can we add a quick healthcheck script that runs after each stage and posts status? i'll drop one in the runbook.

maia: please do. put healthcheck outputs to /release-1739994000/health.json so deploy-bot can index results.

tara: small ask — update the customer-impact blurb in the notes. call out LM latency risk for long conversations during the 5% stage.

maia: done. final draft will be: "Minimal disruption expected. Short-lived latency spikes possible for long chat sessions during early canary; ops monitoring in place." ready to start unless anyone raises a hard blocker.

aj: no blockers from api. :thumbsup:

santiago: runtime LGTM, will keep flag control handy. :white_check_mark:

tara: oncall ready. :rocket:

maia: thanks — kicking the deploy in 10m. will post live timestamp and release-note link in this channel when started. if you want to abort during window, comment `abort` here and @deploy-bot will halt.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy in 10 minutes. starting canary at 2026-03-22T02:10:00Z. logs will stream to https://logs/release-1739994000

maia: (posted) started canary at 2026-03-22T02:10:03Z — 5% traffic now.

aj: seeing initial telemetry, metrics look nominal. :thumbsup:

ryan: eviction counters stable so far.

santiago: index job started (console). ETA ~8m.

maia: thanks team — will update on next stage transition.
